title: Senate approves sweeping bill to regulate college sports
description: The Senate on Thursday approved a sweeping college sports bill to establish a federal framework for college athletics aimed at protecting student athletes — despite some pushback from some Democrats who argue that it could do the opposite.

title: US Hits Canada With Ban on Some Dairy and Liquor Products
description: An outright ban on certain Canadian products took effect Tuesday, escalating a damaging trade fight between the two North American allies.

title: The Russian Prison That Evan Gershkovich Carried Home
description: In an interview, Mr. Gershkovich, a Wall Street Journal reporter who was imprisoned in Russia for 16 months, described his ordeal and the moment that nearly broke him.

title: A Turkish Doughnut Maker Whose Sweets Honor the Dead
description: For one Istanbul confectioner, distributing fried dough balls as memorials is not just a job. It’s personal.

title: Prime Minister Andy Burnham’s Labour Conference Speech Will Aim to Reset UK Mood
description: Prime Minister Andy Burnham is expected to lay out his policy plans in an address on Tuesday at the Labour Party’s annual conference.

title: States Tackle High Gas Prices as Trump Predicts Relief After Midterms
description: California and Georgia take steps to lower costs for drivers as AAA expects September gas prices to set a record.

title: Lindsay Clancy's push to probe holdout juror hits snag before pivotal retrial hearing
description: Lindsay Clancy returns to court in person as her defense pushes a double jeopardy motion and seeks to investigate holdout juror Michael Desronvil.
